mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.school_id, c.parent_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.enabled_status, c.sort_no, c.remark, c.create_time, c.create_user, c.update_time FROM t_as_course_category c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_valid = 1

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.school_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.sort_no FROM t_as_course_category c
c.is_valid = 1 AND c.enabled_status = 1
AND c.school_id = #{query.schoolId}
AND c.parent_id = #{query.parentId}
AND c.parent_id is null
AND c.category_name LIKE concat('%', #{query.categoryName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.sort_no ASC
